[[File:Energy_torpedo_Manta.jpg|thumb|right|250px|A [[Manta droid subfighter]] firing energy torpedoes.]]
The '''energy torpedo''' was a variant of normal [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] weapons. It was made of [[fusion plasma]] which was shot into a magnetic bottle at the target. The magnetic field which contained the plasma could not hold it together more than a minute, but the speed of the energy torpedo allowed it to cover a huge distance in a short time.

An energy torpedo was a kind of missile with an unlimited supply of ammunition. Lacking electronics, these torpedoes could only fly in a straight line and had to be "dumb-fired". The huge weight of the launcher and extended recharge time prevented the energy torpedo from becoming a standard weapon. The recharge time of a light torpedo was 30 seconds, medium ones had a recharge time of 45 seconds and the large [[energy torpedo launcher]]s needed one minute to recharge. The speed of an energy torpedo was 20% the speed of light in addition to the firing ship's movement in the direction of launch.

[[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]] and [[Manta droid subfighter]]s were equipped with two energy torpedo launchers.
